title: Routing door (canonical CONTEXT table -> bundle citations) and doc-deferral door
action: Per plan v2 kds-3 (D2+D3). ROUTING DOOR: new context_table.rs parser — heading '## Locked Decisions', first following pipe table whose header row STARTS WITH '| ID | Decision' (prefix-tolerant: the canonical 3-column template header at context-template.md:26 parses; docs/history/doc-impact-synthesis/CONTEXT.md itself must parse — test it), rows '| D<n> | ... |'. build_routing_door: (a) parseable table -> each D-ID routed when docs/knowledge/ carries '<slug> D<n>' in plain, range ('D1-D3' covers members), or slash-list ('D1/D3') form, or the decision's logged short8, in body or frontmatter decisions list — or a logged decision tagged feature-local names '<slug> D<n>'. Unrouted D-IDs block with both remedies in detail. Cited in >1 area -> report-only duplication warning (recorded deviation from exactly-one). (b) No canonical table -> LOUD report-only notice naming the legacy-form gap and the campaign row; never blocks (recorded deviation bounded by D4). DOC-DEFERRAL DOOR (D3): scan set = capped cells' files_changed filtered to docs/ UNION docs/history/<feature>/ files on disk; FULL-TEXT scan (no git); a line matching matches_deferral_prose (verbs_read.rs:340) without a same-line trigger citation (backtick trigger id or [[trigger:<id>]]) resolving via trigger_registered (triggers/mod.rs:278) blocks with the create-the-trigger teach line; lines inside ``` fences skipped. Both doors: recorded-deferral escape same shape (tags routing-deferral / doc-deferral); slot after impact door in exit chain + all doors vecs. Tests: canonical table routes across all three citation forms; this feature's own CONTEXT.md parses; legacy bullet CONTEXT -> notice, no block; unrouted blocks; feature-local clears; multi-area warns only; deferral line without trigger blocks and with registered trigger clears; fenced code never trips; escapes demote each door.

truths: the canonical template header and this feature's own CONTEXT table both parse
unrouted D-IDs block with the two remedies; legacy-form CONTEXT yields a loud notice and never blocks
range and slash citation forms count as routed
deferral prose in touched docs without a registered trigger blocks; with one it clears; code fences exempt
each door demotes on its recorded deferral decision
